# seerr_notification_agent_test (Resource)

Trigger a test notification delivery via `/api/v1/settings/notifications/{agent}/test`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent` (String) The notification agent type to test (e.g. `discord`, `email`, `gotify`, `lunasea`, `ntfy`, `pushbullet`, `pushover`, `slack`, `telegram`, `webhook`, `webpush`).

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary map of values (such as timestamps or hashes) that, when changed, will re-trigger the test notification delivery.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
